title: Mall World Scavenger Hunt
content: Did anyone experience a large scale scavenger hunt type activity recently in MW? I can't remember everything, but here were some things that stuck out to me: 1. Updated part of the mall. Very sleek, modern with dark wood and clean lines. 2. Lots of floating or backless wooden stairs. 3. Raced upstairs to get the clue, only for it to be in a space that was back downstairs. 4. Hotel or house with a stream or small river running through the floor. 5. Lots of dead-ends getting back downstairs. 6. Lots of people were participating in this activity, not sure what the prize was. If more comes to me, I'll drop it in the comments. I haven't been to MW in a while, so this was a new experience from my previous visits. Just checking to see if anyone else participated.
